# RehabLookup

> Verified directory of 3,800+ addiction treatment facilities across the United
> States. Free concierge placement, insurance verification, and recovery resources.
> Not a treatment provider. Confidential, 24/7 support at 214-639-6420.

## Treatment finders
- [Drug & Alcohol Rehab Directory](https://rehablookup.com/): Search facilities by location, type, and insurance
- [Free Concierge Placement](https://rehablookup.com/concierge): Hand-matched placement within 24–48 hours
- [Browse by State](https://rehablookup.com/rehab-centers/california): State-level directory (50 states + DC)
